response.overview: Amid the anonymous bustle of an airport, Gabi discovers a stain on her white shoe. That small mishap—almost invisible to anyone else—begins to stir something inside her: a restlessness that clouds her day and opens windows onto memories she thought had long since faded.  Desbordes is a sensory journey through the cracks of memory and the fragments that hold us together. A journey through cold lights, silences, and symbols that insist on reappearing. What happens to Gabi cannot be fully explained: it is felt, sensed, breathed. The true transformation begins when the stain ceases to be just a stain.
response.title: Desbordes
